settings.title: What’s inside
settings.text:
19 ingredients in 2 capsules. Every amount is on the label, so you can check it.

NR (300mg). The main one. A form of vitamin B3 that your body uses to make NAD+. 300mg is the most allowed in the UK.

8 B vitamins, in their active form. Your body can use them straight away. They help reduce tiredness and help your body get energy from food.

Vitamin D3 and K2. Vitamin D helps keep your muscles and bones working normally. K2 works alongside it.

Zinc and copper. They help protect your cells.

CoQ10 and PQQ. Found in every cell. Your body makes less CoQ10 as you get older.

Grape seed, resveratrol and BioPerine® (black pepper extract). Plant extracts. BioPerine helps your body take in the rest.

No caffeine. No fillers. Vegan.

settings.title: Who it’s for
settings.text:
Made for adults over 35. Most of our customers are in their 40s and 50s.

It’s for you if: you still work, exercise or look after a family, and you’re not ready to slow down. You feel more tired in the afternoon than you used to. Exercise takes longer to get over. Or you take lots of supplements and don’t know which ones work.

You don’t need to be sporty, or own a smartwatch. Walkers, gardeners and gym-goers all take it.

It’s not for anyone under 18, or if you’re pregnant or breastfeeding. Take medicine? Ask your doctor first.
